descriptionMarkdown:
Normal quality promethium ship.

Can store up to 24k of promethium asteroids. 


Needs to fly between inner planets for a while to stock enough ammo.

Flies at full speed from nauvis to solar system edge and then crawls toward shattered planet at ~100 km/s, collecting asteroids. 

The ship has the potential to reach shattered planets if it is fully upgraded to legendary quality and replaces some of its inserters with stack inserters.
title: Normal quality promethium ship
